Our culture

A Happy Place To Work

At SCS, we believe in delivering remarkable experiences to both our customers and our team members.

Inclusion & diversity

Everyone belongs here

SCS believes that a diverse and inclusive environment establishes a sense of belonging among employees. When people feel more connected at the workplace, it unleashes innovation and allows our team to perform better every day.

Our purpose in conducting business is to serve our people, clients and communities while accelerating equality for all. This commitment drives our innovation agenda and ensures we act as a responsible business in society.

Benefits

Why you'll love working here

Equal opportunities for everyone — and real support to grow, professionally and personally.

Learning & certifications

We encourage technical training and certifications to expose you to best practices in the industry.

People-first mentoring

We focus on nurturing people skills so you can give your best performance at work.

Work-life balance

We encourage and support a healthy balance between your work and your life.

Celebrations together

Diwali, Independence Day, birthdays, New Year and our Foundation Day — we celebrate as a team.

Life @ SCS

We work hard, we celebrate harder

A look at the moments that make SCS feel like family.

Diwali Celebration

At SCS, we make sure the entire team celebrates Diwali by amalgamating prosperity and safety together.

Independence Day

Team SCS celebrated Independence Day with pride, honoring our freedom fighters and enjoying patriotic performances.

Birthday Celebrations

We celebrate every team member's birthday with joy and appreciation — cake cutting, laughter and warm wishes.

New Year Celebration

We welcome the New Year with positivity, team bonding and exciting celebrations — reflecting on achievements and setting new goals.

Foundation Day (22 December)

Foundation Day marks the beginning of our journey. We celebrate with gratitude, team spirit and pride in our achievements.

Hiring process

From application to offer in 4 steps

A simple, transparent process — you'll always know where you stand.

1. Apply online

Send your application through our form — it takes just a few minutes.

2. Screening call

A short call to get to know you, your interests and your availability.

3. Interview

A technical and culture-fit conversation with the team you'd join.

4. Offer & onboarding

Receive your offer and get a guided start with a mentor by your side.

Don't see your role listed?

We're always happy to hear from talented people. Send us your application and we'll reach out when a matching position opens up.
